name: Medici Bank founded at Florence
summary: Giovanni di Bicci de' Medici founds the Banco Medici in Florence on 1 October 1397, opening branches in Rome, Venice, and Geneva. The bank's holding-company structure of partially-independent branches becomes the template for early modern multinational banking.

_quarry.structural_significance: Replaces the failed Bardi/Peruzzi 'super-companies' with a limited-liability partnership architecture; the Medici Bank's tight alliance with the papacy underpins the family's rise to political control of Florence.
